faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.intro: Find answers to the most common questions about Tikeo. Can't find yours? Contact us directly.
faqPage.q1: How do I buy a ticket on Tikeo?
faqPage.a1: Search for an event, choose your ticket type and quantity, then pay online with Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Wave or a bank card. Your digital ticket with QR Code is immediately available in your "My tickets" space.
faqPage.q2: How do I get my tickets after purchase?
faqPage.a2: Your tickets are automatically saved in your personal space, under "My tickets", and also emailed to you. Show the QR Code at the entrance, on your phone or printed.
faqPage.q3: Can I get a refund for a ticket?
faqPage.a3: Refund conditions depend on the policy set by each organizer for their event. If an event is cancelled or postponed by the organizer, you are automatically notified of the next steps.
faqPage.q4: How do I create an event as an organizer?
faqPage.a4: Create an organizer account, complete your profile, then use the 4-step event creation wizard to fill in the details, ticket types and publish your event page.
faqPage.a5: Tikeo supports the main mobile money methods in West Africa (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Wave) as well as Visa and Mastercard bank cards.
faqPage.q6: How much does it cost to use Tikeo as an organizer?
faqPage.a6: Tikeo takes a commission on each ticket sold, with no fixed fee to create an event. Full details of our plans are available on the Organizer pricing page.
faqPage.q7: How do I change or reset my password?
faqPage.a7: From the login page, click "Forgot password" and follow the instructions sent by email to set a new password.
faqPage.q8: How do I check tickets at the entrance of my event?
faqPage.a8: A QR Code access control scanner, available from your organizer space, lets you validate each ticket in real time on the day of the event.
faqPage.stillQuestion: Can't find the answer to your question?
faqPage.noResultsHint: Try other keywords or contact our team directly.
faqPage.q9: Can I give or transfer a ticket to someone?
faqPage.a9: Yes, if the organizer allows transfers for their event. From "My tickets", pick the ticket then "Transfer": the person receives a link to accept it, and the ticket is then attached to their account.
faqPage.q10: The event is sold out, what can I do?
faqPage.a10: Join the waiting list from the event page: you are notified as soon as a spot opens up.
faqPage.q11: How do I use a promo code?
faqPage.a11: Enter your code in the order summary before paying: the discount applies automatically if the code is valid for the event.
faqPage.q12: Can I create promo codes for my event?
faqPage.a12: Yes. From your organizer space, "Promo codes" section, you set the discount, the validity period and the number of uses.

termsPage.title: Terms of use
termsPage.intro: These terms govern the use of the Tikeo platform by buyers and event organizers. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to these terms.
termsPage.s1Text: Tikeo is an event ticketing platform that connects event organizers with ticket buyers, and provides online sales, payment and access control tools.
termsPage.s2Text: Some features require creating an account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account.
termsPage.s3Text: Every ticket bought on Tikeo comes with a unique, personal QR Code. It must be shown, digitally or printed, to access the relevant event. Tikeo is not responsible for the content, running or cancellation of an event, which is the organizer's responsibility.
termsPage.s4Text: Displayed prices are set by the organizer and include, where applicable, Tikeo's service fees. Payment is made online through the methods offered on the platform (mobile money, bank card).
termsPage.s5Text: If an event is cancelled or postponed by the organizer, buyers are notified and refunded according to the refund policy applicable to that event, shown on the event page.
termsPage.s6Text: The organizer guarantees the accuracy of the information published about their event and agrees to comply with the regulations applicable to running it, including any required permits.
termsPage.s7Text: Tikeo's brands, logos and platform content are protected. Any unauthorized reproduction is prohibited. Organizers retain ownership of the content they publish (visuals, event descriptions).
termsPage.s8Text: Tikeo acts as a technical intermediary between organizers and buyers. Tikeo cannot be held liable for disputes relating to the running of an event, which is the organizer's responsibility.
termsPage.s9Text: These terms are governed by the law of Côte d'Ivoire. Any dispute will, failing an amicable resolution, be submitted to the competent courts of Abidjan.
termsPage.s10Text: For any question about these terms, you can reach us via the Contact page.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what personal data Tikeo collects, why, and how you can exercise your rights.
privacyPage.s1Text: We collect the information you provide (name, email, phone), data related to your orders and tickets, as well as technical browsing data (IP address, device type).
privacyPage.s2Text: Your data is used to create and manage your account, process your orders and payments, generate your tickets, send you useful notifications and improve the platform.
privacyPage.s3Text: Your data is only shared with providers necessary for the service to work (payment, email delivery) and with the organizer of the event you are buying a ticket for, as needed for access control.
privacyPage.s4Text: Your data is kept for as long as necessary to manage your account and orders, then archived or deleted in accordance with applicable legal obligations.
privacyPage.s5Text: In accordance with Ivorian law no. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on the protection of personal data, you have the right to access, correct and delete your data. You can exercise these rights at any time from your "Settings" area or by contacting us, and you may refer a dispute to the ARTCI (Côte d'Ivoire telecommunications/ICT regulatory authority).
privacyPage.s6Text: Tikeo uses cookies that are necessary for the site to work (login, language preferences) and, with your consent, anonymous audience measurement. You can change your choice at any time via "Manage cookies".
privacyPage.s7Text: Payments and ticket verifications are processed server-side, never in the browser, to guarantee the security of your data and transactions.
privacyPage.s8Text: For any question about your personal data, contact us via the Contact page.

organizerPricingPage.title: The more you sell, the less you pay
organizerPricingPage.intro: No subscription or setup fee: Tikeo only earns on paid tickets sold. As your cumulative sales grow, your commission drops automatically.
organizerPricingPage.yourRate: Your current commission: {rate}% ({sales} FCFA in cumulative sales).
organizerPricingPage.yourNext: Only {amount} FCFA more in sales to reach {rate}%.
organizerPricingPage.commissionNote: Commission applies only to paid tickets actually sold. Free events are never charged. The rate applied to a sale is that of your tier at the time of the sale.
organizerPricingPage.payerIntro: For each event, you choose who bears Tikeo's commission. You can change it at any time: the change applies to future sales.
organizerPricingPage.payerOrganizerText: The displayed price is what the buyer pays. The commission is deducted from what you receive. Example: 5,000 FCFA ticket, 6% commission → the buyer pays 5,000 FCFA, you receive 4,700 FCFA.
organizerPricingPage.payerBuyerText: A service fee is added to the ticket price at checkout. You receive the full price. Example: 5,000 FCFA ticket, 6% commission → the buyer pays 5,300 FCFA, you receive 5,000 FCFA.
organizerPricingPage.simIntro: Enter your ticket price and number of sales: see the commission and what you keep, tier by tier, from your first sale.
organizerPricingPage.simAverage: That is {rate}% on average, {perTicket} FCFA per ticket
organizerPricingPage.simIfOrganizerPays: if you cover the commission yourself
organizerPricingPage.simIfBuyerPays: If the buyer pays it: you receive {net} FCFA and each ticket costs the buyer {perTicket} FCFA.
organizerPricingPage.simNote: Indicative estimate on paid tickets, excluding any payment fees.
organizerPricingPage.customText: Large volumes, festivals, dedicated subdomain: contact our team to negotiate a suitable rate.
organizerPricingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about our pricing
organizerPricingPage.faq1q: Are there any fees to create an event?
organizerPricingPage.faq1a: No, creating and publishing an event is free. The commission is only charged on tickets sold.
organizerPricingPage.faq2a: You choose for each event: deduct it from your revenue, or add it as a service fee paid by the buyer.
organizerPricingPage.faq3q: When do I get paid for my sales?
organizerPricingPage.faq3a: Your sales and net amount are visible in real time in your organizer space. Our team will explain the payout terms to you.
organizerPricingPage.faq4q: How does my commission go down?
